name: Sea to Sky Retreat Centre

location.address: 84 Retreat Road, Whistler, BC V8E 0A7, Canada

tradition: Tibetan Buddhism (Vajrayana), non-sectarian centre primarily hosting Khyentse-lineage Nyingma practice programs under Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche and Siddhartha's Intent
technique: Vajrayana practices including Ngondro (foundational practices), guided meditation retreats, and Nyingtik/tantric practice intensives led by qualified instructors
teacherAccess: Programs are led by Siddhartha's Intent instructors (e.g. Bruce Ashton, Cydney Kawamura) and visiting teachers such as Drubgyud Tenzin Rinpoche, with Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche periodically teaching in person; access varies by program.
retreatOptions: Multi-day residential programs ranging from long-weekend guided retreats (e.g. 3-4 nights) to week-plus practice intensives (e.g. an 8-night Ngondro Practice Intensive or 9-night Vimaladrup Tsokbum), plus periodic pujas, drupchods and a family camp; centre is open seasonally mid-March to mid-December.
about: Sea to Sky Retreat Centre (SSRC) is a purpose-built retreat property in Whistler, BC, begun in 1993 by Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche and friends as his only retreat centre in North America. Though non-sectarian in atmosphere and open to a range of contemplative and community programs, SSRC's core activity is hosting residential Buddhist meditation retreats - largely Vajrayana Ngondro and Nyingma practice intensives - organized through Siddhartha's Intent and led by instructors such as Bruce Ashton and Cydney Kawamura, alongside visiting teachers including Drubgyud Tenzin Rinpoche. Typical programs run from long weekends to week-plus practice intensives, with participants staying on site in shared accommodation and meals included in the program fee. The centre operates seasonally from mid-March to mid-December each year and also hosts family camps, work-as-practice volunteer days, and occasional non-Buddhist community gatherings alongside its core dharma calendar.
schedule: Varies by program; multi-day retreats typically run from afternoon arrival on the first day to after-lunch departure on the last, with structured daily sitting/practice sessions, teachings, and communal meals throughout.
cost: No single published nightly rate; multi-day program fees are set individually per retreat by Siddhartha's Intent and typically cover shared room and board as part of the program price.
foodNotes: Room and board are included in multi-day program fees; specific dietary approach is not published on the centre's website.
workNotes: Retreat participation does not require work; the centre separately hosts an occasional optional 'Work as Practice' volunteer weekend hosted by the SSRC volunteer team.
